searchText: I just counted 52 Ethereum channels. I don't know what most any of them are for. Discord beeps constantly - I generally have no idea which conversation it is beeping about. So I mostly ignore them. <@!683653554631868440> you can mute channels your not interested in by right-clicking on them (or even on categories to mute a whole category) <@683653554631868440> In a similar vein to <@360491619402776577> 's suggestion, you can set the channel default to notify only if mentioned so it applies to new channels. Then you can turn new channels up to full notifications at your discretion. I have most channels muted as soon as they appear there are just too many of them Right. But then I find out I've missed two months of important discussions on 7 channels. Oh well, I recommend muting whole categories. Like Bots for example. This place is a low-rent Slack. Low rent, higher quality. 🙂 Maybe... Is there a place where the beeps form a chronological queue? The worst thing is the constant polling of channels to see what is happening. Or hearing a bunch of beeps and having no idea where they came from. Don't worry <@!683653554631868440> We can talk once in a while, I will update you on things that are happening from my point of view. No need to read the whole deluge I just let wash over me like a warm rain. So, what was the result of the breakouts in the end? I know we are doing Monday still, but is that the last one or will they continue? I think that should be one of the agenda items for meeting on Monday 😄 Breakout-room meeting #3 Meeting Date/Time: Monday 21 September 2020, at 14:00 UTC Agenda: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/208 <@!259648573401071617> > i'm weighing eip-2935 against the approach that flyclient proposes, and if i could convince myself that the flyclient approach has enough benefits for it to be worth the additional complexity, I'd be interested in championing it inviting <@!259648573401071617> for EIP-2935, <@!301186049323958275> for EIP-2718 and EIP-2972 If you send out more reminders here in Discord, would be awesome if you could keep tagging me (e.g., day before meeting, hour before meeting). Don't go out of your way for it though. (I will also set an alarm, but the more sources of reminder the better) I am okay adding "@" as long as people are fine with that 😅 The calendar invite has been sent out too, if someone wants to be added/removed, feel free to DM me. EIP-2929 clarification: The changes to the non storage operators is a surcharge on top of the existing costs or does it replace the entire cost? (EXTCODESIZE, EXTCODECOPY, EXTCODEHASH, BALANCE (0x31), CALL, CALLCODE, DELEGATECALL , STATICCALL) . EXTCODECOPY is a variable formula so a straight replacement seems unlikely. Also, how does the WARM_STOAGE_READ_COST interact with the STATICCALL cost reductions for precompiles? Not in YOLOv2 but this seems to undo that change pre-emptively.
